items.summary: Recommendation: approve containment-only execution and retain the allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as slot-gated, but reject any revenue, ROI, contribution-margin, cost-to-learn, budget, or forecast claim. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is tied to tracking_id other and cannot be assigned to a site; site-attributed commission is therefore $0. The allthingsmasonic.com baseline is 61 clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. AI usage from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 is $988.91 across 5,470 calls, including 233 errors. This is observed AI exposure, not total operating cost. Preserve the proposed disclosure, registered-ID, link-integrity, accessibility, build, smoke-test, 14-day-or-100-impression measurement, and rollback gates. Do not spend, deploy, or admit the CTA change until capacity clears and the existing repair disposition is recorded.

Finance boundary: contribution margin cannot be calculated because period-aligned site revenue is unavailable and infrastructure, hosting, domain, labor, and experiment-cost allocation are absent. Cost-to-learn cannot be calculated because no approved learning outcome, experiment-level cost allocation, or cost-to-learn threshold is recorded. Budget exposure cannot be calculated because monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue target, and revenue floor are blank. Minimum measurement is one period-aligned ledger keyed by site, registered affiliate ID, and work item containing revenue, AI cost, infrastructure/hosting/domain cost, labor allocation, experiment cost, learning outcome, and approved learning threshold. Do not request duplicate telemetry; use the existing read-only finance and attribution sources when available.

Pushback on vanity metrics: impressions, clicks, sessions, ordered items, shipped items, proposal counts, delivery throughput, and AI call volume do not establish profitable growth without attributable commission, period alignment, and costs. The candidate plan's 14-day-or-100-impression measurement is acceptable for operational learning, but it must not be converted into an ROI or revenue forecast unless a registered tracking ID produces site-attributed commission and the finance ledger captures incremental cost.
